items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was something else. Detroit Red. And his daughter, Atallah Shabazz, is an incredible human being.

ctx.x: I used to stand out in front of that many times listening to Malcolm. I was so glad again, in light of the diaspora, your references to Malcolm X in the book. I found them very touching, very moving.
He was something else. Detroit Red. And his daughter, Atallah Shabazz, is an incredible human being.

I don’t know if it’s going to take another revolution to get the arts ever being right, because right now people are so proud – certainly Dana [Gioia] is doing a better job than anybody who’s been in there. But still, it’s not – he doesn’t have the resources.
